shortDescription: Remove DHCP leases via Pi-hole v6 API.

options.name: clientid
options.description: The Client ID (DHCP Unique Identifier) of the lease to remove.

options.name: hwaddr
options.description: The hardware (MAC) address of the lease to remove.

options.name: ip
options.description: The IP address of the DHCP lease to remove.

options.name: name
options.description: The hostname of the DHCP lease to remove.

options.name: password
options.description: The API password for the Pi-hole instance.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Pi-hole instance.
